title: [Style Property] Number of Topstitch Line Setting
content: ### **Objective** Set how many lines of Topstitches there are for a single style. ** Location** Object Browser ▶ Topstitch Tab ▶ Property Editor ▶ **Number of Lines** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Topstitch Tab ▶ Property Editor ▶ **Number of Lines** 2. Enter the number of lines as desired. → The **Number of Lines** is now being adjusted and applied. **※ Note :** **Distance of Number of Lines** It is possible to adjust the distance between the lines. The unit of the length can be set in inch, millimeter(mm) or centimeter(cm). When alteration is made in inch(in), it automatically appears in millimeter(mm) or centimeter(cm) and vice versa.
content_description: This web page provides a straightforward guide for adjusting the number of Topstitch lines and their spacing for a selected style in the Property Editor.

title: Copy
content: **List of Contents** Copy Copy a Pattern Copy an Internal Shape **Copy** \- Copy Patterns and Internal Shapes. ** Copy a Pattern** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EDcMcsPVZME \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right-click on the Pattern to be duplicated and select **Copy.** \- The selected Pattern will be duplicated. **Copy an Internal Shape** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=95HbFM23Xic \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right-click on the Internal Shape to be duplicated and select **Copy.** \- The selected Internal Shape will be duplicated. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions and video tutorials for copying patterns and internal shapes in a 2D design environment.

title: Avatar Rendering Style
content: **List of Contents** Avatar Rendering Style Textured Surface Mesh Monochrome Surface **Avatar Rendering Style** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tf1CZ881N4Y \- Display Avatars in various Rendering Styles. \- Navigate to the 3D window and hover over the last icon in the Vertical View Toggle Menu. ** Textured Surface** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=75arRzMYPYw \- When an Avatar is loaded, the Textured Surface is applied to the Avatar by default, showing the skin texture of the Avatar. **Mesh** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0bs2bQPrFWI \- Click the Mesh option to see Avatars’ Mesh structure. **Monochrome Surface** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mDNk14u9EvE \- Click the Monochrome Surface option to see Avatars in black and white. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: Explore different avatar rendering styles, including textured, mesh, and monochrome surfaces, through informative videos and interactive navigation.

title: Import - OBJ
content: **List of Contents** Import OBJ Import (Add) OBJ **Import OBJ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fjrW762CniQ \- OBJs can be used as Avatars or other background props compose the 3D environment. \- The 3D Garments created in CLO can be exported as an OBJ to use in other 3D software. \- When a 3D Garment is exported as an OBJ, the file will contain MTL file which saves the texture information. \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select File ▶ Import ▶ **OBJ. ** \- Locate the OBJ file and select **Open.** \- The Import OBJ window will appear. \- **Load Type** : Select either to open or add the OBJ file. \- **Object Type** : select the type of the OBJ file \- **Scale** : select the unit of the OBJ When the**Auto Scale** option is selected, CLO will detect the unit of the OBJ automatically. \- Axis Conversion: Change the axis of the OBJ. \- Translation: designate the position of the OBJ. \- Select OK to open the OBJ based on the settings. ** Import (Add) OBJ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyutFBV0R2Q \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select File ▶ Import (Add) ▶ **OBJ. ** \- Locate the OBJ file and select **Open.** \- The selected OBJ file will be added to the workspace. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on importing OBJ files into CLO, including step-by-step instructions and helpful resources for utilizing 3D garments and props effectively.

title: New
content: **List of Contents** New Create a New File **New ** \- Delete the Garment in the current workspace and create a new Garment. \- Navigate to Main Menu ▶ File ▶ **New.** ** Create a New File** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k41mizmVef4 \- The **New** option is activated only when a file is already open. \- Navigate to and select Main Menu ▶ File ▶ **New.** \- The dialogue asking to save the current file will pop up. \- Select the desired option and the current file will either be saved or deleted based on the selection and a new file will open. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to create a new file by deleting the current garment in your workspace, complete with navigation instructions and a helpful YouTube tutorial.

title: Divide Internal Lines
content: **List of Contents** Divide Internal Point Divide Internal Line **Objective** Cut and separate Internal Lines or points from an Internal Shape or continuous Internal Line. ** Location** **Divide Internal Point** Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Point) ▶ **Divide Internal Point** ** Divide Internal Line** Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Line) ▶ **Divide Internal Line** ** Operation** **Divide Internal Point** 1. Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001095927/2.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Point) ▶**Internal Point** → The Internal Line is divided at the selected point. → The divided point is now indicated as a point with no fill. **Divide Internal Line** 1. Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001095927/2.png)**Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Line) ▶ **Divide Internal Line** → The Internal Line is divided from its original Internal Shape. → Both ends of the Internal Line are indicated with points with no fill. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for dividing internal points and lines within a shape using the right-click pop-up menu in the editing tool.

title: Zoom Extents All
content: **List of Contents** Zoom Extents All Result of Zoom Extents All **Zoom Extents All** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=itMSQhNGJmU \- See all Patterns in the 3D window without changing the view in the 3D window. \- Right-click on the 3D window and select **Zoom Extents All.** ** Result of Zoom Extents All** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zKdrezg9PE4 \- Right-click on the 3D window and select **Zoom Extents All.** \- The 3D window will scale automatically to show all Patterns. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: Explore the functionality of "Zoom Extents All" in the 3D window to view all patterns seamlessly, enhanced with instructional YouTube videos for a comprehensive understanding.

title: Mirror Paste

the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right-click on the Pattern to be duplicated and select **Copy.** \- The selected Pattern will be duplicated. \- Right-click on the 2D window and select **Mirror Paste** from the pop-up menu. \- The duplicated Pattern will follow along the mouse cursor. \- Click on the 2D window to Mirror Paste the Pattern. \- The identical Pattern will be created in the 2D window. * **Mirror Paste an Internal Shape YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9n_hHeRgyD0 ** \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right-click on the Internal Shape to be duplicated and select **Copy.** \- The selected Internal Shape will be duplicated. \- Right-click on the 2D window and select **Mirror Paste** from the pop-up menu. \- The duplicated Internal Shape will follow along the mouse cursor. \- Click within the Pattern to Mirror Paste the Internal Shape. \- The identical Internal Shape will be created in the 2D window. **Mirror Paste with Specific Values** * **Mirror Paste a Pattern** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VLK--MQ92z0 \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right-click on the Pattern to be duplicated and select **Copy.** \- The selected Pattern will be duplicated. \- Right click on the 2D window and select **Mirror Paste** from the pop-up menu. \- The duplicated Pattern will follow along the mouse cursor. \- Right-click on the 2D window to access the Paste pop-up window. \- Enter the desired values to **Internal** and **Number of Shapes**. Then, click OK. 。 \- The Pattern will be mirror pasted based on the settings. * **Mirror Paste an Internal Shape YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vW2MiCU21aE ** \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) Edit Pattern tool. \- Right-click on the Internal Shape to be duplicated and select **Copy**. \- The selected Internal Shape will be duplicated. \- Right-click on the 2D window and select **Mirror Paste** from the pop-up menu. \- The duplicated Internal Shape will follow along the mouse cursor. \- Right-click on the 2D window to access the Paste pop-up window. \- Enter the desired values to Interval, Number of Shapes, and Position. Then, click OK. \- The Internal Shape will be mirror pasted based on the settings. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for utilizing the Mirror Paste feature in design software, providing step-by-step instructions and video tutorials for duplicating patterns and internal shapes with precision.

title: Show All Piping
content: **Show All Piping** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kP1sFAbPm28 \- Show all Pipings in the 3D window. \- Right-click on the 3D window and select **Show All Piping** from the pop-up menu. \- All Pipings in the 3D window will appear.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide instructions on how to display all piping in a 3D window using the "Show All Piping" feature.

title: Reset 2D Arrangement (Selected)
content: **Reset 2D Arrangement (Selected)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T4PCSgMtL98 \- Re-arrange 3D Patterns according to the Pattern arrangement in the 2D window. \- Right-click on the Pattern to be re-arranged and select **Reset 2D Arrangement (Selected)** from the pop-up menu. \- Selected Patterns will be re-arranged in the 3D window reflecting the Pattern arrangement in the 2D window.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to reset and rearrange selected 3D patterns to match the layout shown in the 2D window using a simple right-click menu option.

title: Flip Normal
content: **Flip Normal** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXAxw-7CpbM \- Easily flip the Pattern inside-out. \- Choose the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021552387/mceclip0.png) **Select/Move** tool from 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. \- Right-click on the 3D Garment and select **Flip Normal.** \- The selected Pattern will flip inside-out, face side will flip to the backside and vice-versa. \- When Fold Angles are assigned to the flipped Pattern, Fold Angles will be reversed.
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on how to easily flip the pattern inside-out in CLO 3D using the Flip Normal feature, enhancing your garment design process.

title: Pin – Delete All Pins
content: **Pin - Delete All Pins** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WwHlVqLVnBY \- Delete all pins on the 3D Garment. \- Choose the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021552387/mceclip0.png) **Select****/Move** tool from the 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. \- Right-click on the 3D Garment and Select pin ▶ **Delete All Pins.** \- All pins created on the 3D Garment will be deleted.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to delete all pins from a 3D garment in Clo3D.

title: Lock All Internal Lines
content: **Lock All Internal Lines** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DcZtWcbZMvU \- Lock all Internal Lines to inhibit selecting and editing in the 2D window. \- Right-click on the 2D window and select **Lock All Internal Lines** from the pop-up menu. All Internal Lines will turn grey and be deactivated. \- Only activated Patterns can be selected and edited.
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on how to lock all internal lines in the 2D window to prevent selection and editing, ensuring that only activated patterns remain editable.

title: Superimpose (Under)
content: **Superimpose (Under)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oBF_n-nI2b0 \- When a Pattern is sewn to another Pattern, place one below the other’s surface based on the Sewing Lines. \- Choose the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021552387/mceclip0.png) **Select****/Move** tool from the 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. \- Right-click on the 3D Garment and select **Superimpose (Under).** \- The selected Pattern will be arranged under the sewn pair along its surface. \- The Superimpose (Under) function can be used only when two Patterns are sewn to each other.
content_description: Learn how to effectively use the Superimpose (Under) feature in garment design to position one pattern beneath another based on sewing lines for precise layering.

title: Superimpose (Side)
content: **Superimpose (Side)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RxcdD-agS9s \- When a Pattern is sewn to another Pattern, place one next to the other’s side based on the Sewing Lines. \- Choose the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021552387/mceclip0.png) **Select/****Move** tool from the 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. \- Right-click on the 3D Garment and select Superimpose (Side). \- The selected Pattern will be arranged next to the sewn pair along its side. \- The Superimpose (Side) function can be used only when two Patterns are sewn to each other.
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on using the Superimpose (Side) function in garment design to accurately position sewn patterns next to each other in a 3D environment.

title: Flip Vertically (2D)
content: **Flip Vertically (2D)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Obd4_EcnqH0 \- Flip a Pattern vertically in the 2D window. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and right click on the Pattern to be flipped and select **Flip Vertically.** \- The selected Pattern will be flipped vertically.
content_description: Learn how to easily flip a pattern vertically in the 2D window using the Transform Pattern tool in this step-by-step guide.

title: Flip Horizontally (2D)
content: **Flip Horizontally (2D)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Mz9OacKL3U \- Flip a Pattern horizontally in the 2D window. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and right click on the Pattern to be flipped and select **Flip Horizontally.** \- The selected Pattern will be flipped horizontally.
content_description: Learn how to easily flip a pattern horizontally in the 2D window using the Transform Pattern tool with our step-by-step guide and video tutorial.

title: Delete Reference Line
content: **Delete Reference Line**** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=goAmcFl0u2k \- Delete the Reference Line originally created to use as a guide when editing a Pattern. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Right-click on the Pattern and select **Delete Reference Line** from the pop-up menu. \- The selected Pattern’s Reference Line will be deleted. \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. Then, click and drag to move the desired point or line on the Pattern to confirm.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to delete a reference line from a pattern in CLO 3D, ensuring a streamlined editing process.

title: Cut
content: **List of Contents** Cut Use Cut **Cut** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iePM0xMk37E \- Cut Patterns based on the Internal Line. \- The CUT can be operated with following tools: * Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern** tool * Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ **Trace** tool ** Use Cut** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wh8bS7Ml70Y \- Navigate to and select following tools: * Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern** tool * Trace tool \- Right-click on the Internal Line and select **Cut** from the pop-up menu. \- The Pattern will cut based on the Internal Line. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides instructional resources and video tutorials on using the Cut tool for editing patterns based on internal lines in a design software.
